title: Electron Microscopy and Structural Studies of Iron Oxides Nanoparticles Produced by using Sonochemical Synthesis
content: Iron oxide NPs present an exceptional combination of very interesting and intrinsic properties as, high surface area and chemical reactivity, which makes them versatile for applications in fields such as medicine, catalysis, environmental remediation and electronics [1, 2]. In biomedicine, especially iron oxides such as magnetite, hematite and maghemite are used as contrast agents for magnetic resonance imaging and as controlled drug release vectors. They have also been used in magnetic hyperthermia therapy, where light absorption is used. to generate heat and destroy cancer cells [3, 4]. In addition to their use in the previously mentioned applications, studies have revealed that these nanoparticles have antibacterial and antifungal properties, which makes them ideal candidates to be used against pathogens and harmful microorganisms.
